The changes to the scope are acceptable because the resulting design complies with 35 USC 112(a) and (b). Specifically, applicant was in possession of the design now claimed, in D1,032,053. “A reissue applicant must acknowledge the existence of an error in the specification, drawings, or claims, which error causes the original patent to be defective. Claim 18 is indefinite because it recites a tile that “consists of aluminum oxide and materials selected from the group consisting of crystalline silica and magnesium oxide”.  As there are only two “materials” in the group, it is not clear if “materials selected from the group consisting of” requires both materials to be “selected”
